en.title: Reduce temporary allocations in Spine display geometry
en.body: Spine converts packed colors directly into Float32 components and passes the Core-owned used UV and index ranges directly to the existing synchronous immutable shared-geometry factory. Captured geometry, animation ordering, validation and display lifetime remain unchanged.

zh.title: 减少 Spine 显示几何的临时分配
zh.body: Spine 将打包颜色直接写为 Float32 分量，并将 Core 已使用范围的 UV 与索引直接交给已有的同步不可变共享几何工厂。捕获几何、动画事件顺序、校验与显示生命周期保持不变。
